conditional_CONF_current_status: HOLD; identities are fixed but no CONF source text, length, annotations, model outputs or predictions may be opened now
source_role: Original licensed ContractNLI TRAIN is project DEV and, only if eligible, reserved project confirmation; never official source heldout testing
selection: Metadata-only once; no redraw or rebalance after aliases, lengths, classes, runtime, model behavior or scores. A collision causes HOLD.
reader_eligibility_before_CONF: Exact pinned immutable reader weights, tokenizer, config and trained genuine three-way classification head; no random/reinitialized/missing active learned tensors
Auditable weight and supervised-training dataset licenses and head-training/selection/calibration provenance

Positive evidence excludes ContractNLI from reader supervised training, model selection and calibration. An exact preserved head artifact proven released before public ContractNLI may establish chronological exclusion; a current card date or unverified lineage does not.
Foundation web-text or fuzzy contract overlap can remain unknown but must be disclosed separately; it is not proof of absence and does not excuse unknown supervised/head lineage
Current DEV24 labels and outputs cannot choose a second head or alter retrieval, packing, thresholds, logits, softmax, class mapping or any source
All previous attempts closed and actual remaining worker, time, CPU, model and native limits proven
CONF_activation_requires: Conjunction of eligible reader provenance, complete accepted frozen DEV gate, clean source and execution audits, same unchanged candidate source, fixed CONF identities, and prospectively admitted remaining time/resources. Otherwise close the epoch DEV-only with no reserved consumption.
CONF_gate: Freeze exact metric and candidate-versus-control improvement thresholds in the final protocol before any new source input projection or measurement. No metric-dependent relaxation or a second try after failure.

champion_promotion.required_comparator: Actually execute and preserve the exact champion pipeline on the same fixed CONF24 cases under the frozen budget, with predeclared paired improvement checks. If only an excerpt-conditioned old-head control is measured, scope the claim to that excerpt head and retain the champion.
champion_promotion.binary_champion: If champion supplies binary noul, freeze candidate Entailment versus Contradiction+NotMentioned collapse and compare binary accuracy, NLL and Brier on identical cases. Three-way class gates remain separate.
champion_promotion.unmatched_or_unavailable_champion_implie: No champion promotion regardless retrieval-control result

gold_access: First selected annotation choice join occurs only after every fixed ordered input and all finite three-way logits/probabilities are validated, complete output identities sealed, and owned worker/helper processes physically absent. Join only the fixed24 source choices for that phase. Partial/error outputs do not authorize label access.
isolation: The complete public annotated JSON is parsed by the builder and scorer; field-use isolation is logical, not OS-enforced secrecy. No label fields are traversed during projection.
statistics: Eight document groups with three correlated hypotheses; no IID24-case interval, population superiority or generalization claim. Prior different-bank 11/24 is historical only.
interpretation: Retrieved-context NotMentioned is a diagnostic class prediction. Retrieval omission, numeric loss, references, truncation, overflow or missing context cannot establish global legal absence or insufficiency.

network_policy_before_launch.only_bind_exception: AF_INET exact ('127.0.0.1', port) or AF_INET6 exact ('::1', port) / ('::1', port, 0, 0); type(port) is int and not bool, range0..65535; explicit flow/scope exact int0 not bool
network_policy_before_launch.all_connect_DNS_send_recv_listen_and_non: fatal, counted before raising, persistent rejection even if caught
network_policy_before_launch.allowed_bind_audit: Separate counter and append-only event containing exact address, family, stack and success or exception outcome; not counted as a forbidden network operation

exposure_retirement.rule: All selected document identities are spent for their fixed role on first input exposure, including failure. No replacements or relabeling of roles.
